parameters.jsCode:
const items = ($input.first().json.opportunities || $input.first().json.items || []).filter((o) => (o.consent?.whatsapp === 'opt_in' || o.consent?.sms === 'opt_in'));
return items.map((o) => ({ json: { leadId: o.id, name: o.name || o.id, city: o.city, state: o.state, score: o.score ?? 60, channelFit: o.channelFit ?? 0.6, consent: o.consent || { whatsapp: 'opt_in', sms: 'opt_in', call: 'none' }, draft: { whatsapp: `Olá ${o.name || 'lead'}, vimos uma oportunidade relevante em LandMap.`, sms: `LandMap: oportunidade ${o.name || o.id} pronta.` } } }));

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { leadId: $json.leadId, name: $json.name, city: $json.city, state: $json.state, score: $json.score, stage: 'qualified', engagement: 1, intent: $json.channelFit, followUpsSent: 0, daysSinceActivity: 1, toleranceDays: 7, channelFit: $json.channelFit, consent: $json.consent, timezone: 'America/Sao_Paulo', draft: $json.draft } }}
